name: grok.com revenue orchestrator
connect: Keep the existing grok.com GitHub connection as the code and exact-byte road.
Use the canonical Commons MCP URL for route_grokcom_revenue_work; do not mint a second MCP server.
Install plugins/commons-grok-cloud once so fresh GPT cloud sessions can execute returned Grok packets through the shared browser.
Before one intentional browser submission, call start_grok_capture and require its write-ahead acknowledgment; exact run-key/URL duplicates never submit again.
Capture every partial/terminal output through capture_grok_run; recover_grok_capture is output-only and never replays a finished prompt.
Use GROK_CONTINUE only for a new lineage-linked prompt after GPT identifies real unfinished work.
Send every Slack event through INTAKE and post the returned slack_reply in the originating thread.
Let Grok use Commons too: connect the same public MCP directly when available, otherwise forward build_grok_commons_client envelopes losslessly and return each MCP response to the same conversation.
Send the verified capture through GROKCOM_RESULT, GPT_REVIEW, optional lineage-linked GROK_CONTINUE, GIT_LAND, and then continue the queue.

cloud_executor.browser: ChatGPT cloud CDP / existing grok.com session
cloud_executor.receipt: stable run key; actual grok.com/c/... URL/rid; exact prompts/result; originating task/session; provider-private artifact paths plus exposed hashes/sizes; visible model/mode/source/token/debit evidence; timestamps; terminal state; zero-token/no-mutation boundary
cloud_executor.no_replay: Finished prompts are never replayed. A real unfinished edge gets one new deterministic run key with parent run/conversation lineage.
cloud_executor.failure_route: First exact Cloudflare/login/browser/page error is captured and RELEASED with zero spend; do not retry-loop, bypass, or substitute GPT/Codex for the heavy assignment.

credentials: No Slack, GitHub, xAI, or grok.com credential is accepted by the Commons tool or stored in this repository.
loop_rule: All messages are processed. Only an exact COMMONS_GROKCOM_REVENUE self-echo returns post_reply=false.
